lines.zh: 我的每一步，黄金地面都会震。
lines.en: Every step of mine shakes the golden floor.

lines.zh: 关节里的弹簧在响，一下一下。
lines.en: The springs in my joints click, once and again.

lines.zh: 我朝你走，不绕路。
lines.en: I walk straight at you, never around.

lines.zh: 黄金压肩，我走得很稳。
lines.en: Gold weighs on my shoulders, yet my gait is steady.

lines.zh: 我的步子沉，退路早忘了。
lines.en: My steps are heavy, and I forgot retreat long ago.

lines.zh: 脚底的金属磨得发亮。
lines.en: The metal of my soles is worn shiny.

lines.zh: 我数着步数接近你。
lines.en: I count my steps as I close in on you.

lines.zh: 黄金地面太滑，我踩得很稳。
lines.en: The gold floor is slick; I plant my feet firmly.

lines.zh: 我的影子在金子上是黑的。
lines.en: My shadow looks black on the gold.

lines.zh: 让我走近些，我要看清你的护甲。
lines.en: Let me get closer; I want a look at your armor.

lines.zh: 我身上的电流在走，跟着脚步。
lines.en: Current runs through me, matching my stride.

lines.zh: 再走十步，我们就面对面了。
lines.en: Ten more steps and we stand face to face.

lines.zh: 站得太久，我的膝关节有点涩。
lines.en: Standing so long, my knee joints have stiffened.

lines.zh: 我在听大厅里的回声。
lines.en: I am listening to the echoes in the hall.

lines.zh: 电流低低地流，像水。
lines.en: The current flows low, like water.

lines.zh: 没有对手，我就擦我的甲。
lines.en: With no opponent, I polish my armor.

lines.zh: 黄金不会生锈，我会。
lines.en: Gold does not rust. I do.

lines.zh: 我在数柱子的根数。
lines.en: I am counting the pillars.

lines.zh: 核心偶尔跳一下，是旧伤。
lines.en: My core skips now and then; an old wound.

lines.zh: 我的弹簧松了半圈。
lines.en: My spring has slackened half a turn.

lines.zh: 空着的这座厅，比战场还吵。
lines.en: This empty hall is louder than a battlefield.

lines.zh: 我闭不上眼，只能站着等。
lines.en: I cannot close my eyes; I can only stand and wait.

lines.zh: 你站得挺直，像受过训练。
lines.en: You stand straight, like someone trained.

lines.zh: 我打量你，先看手，再看脚。
lines.en: I size you up: hands first, then feet.

lines.zh: 你的武器不合手，握得太紧。
lines.en: Your weapon does not suit you; you grip too tight.

lines.zh: 别躲我的目光，战士要看着对方。
lines.en: Do not avoid my gaze; warriors face each other.

lines.zh: 你这副样子，值得我认真。
lines.en: The way you stand, you are worth my effort.

lines.zh: 我在算你这身甲值几锤。
lines.en: I am counting how many hammer blows your armor is worth.

lines.zh: 金光反射在你脸上，晃眼吧。
lines.en: The gold light bounces off your face. Bright, is it not?

lines.zh: 我看了你三秒，够长了。
lines.en: I have looked at you three seconds. That is long enough.

lines.zh: 你喘得急，铁肺也会漏气。
lines.en: You pant quickly; even iron lungs leak.

lines.zh: 我这副面孔是铸的，不会笑。
lines.en: This face was cast; it does not smile.

lines.zh: 你身上没有黄金，可惜。
lines.en: There is no gold on you. A pity.

lines.zh: 我们对视，就算打过招呼了。
lines.en: Our eyes met, so consider us introduced.

lines.zh: 甲凹了，人没倒。
lines.en: The plate dented; I did not fall.

lines.zh: 这一下打在补过的地方。
lines.en: That landed on the patched spot.

lines.zh: 电流从伤口漏出去了。
lines.en: Current is leaking from the wound.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，是战术。
lines.en: Half a step back, and it is tactical.

lines.zh: 你砍得动黄金，不错。
lines.en: You can cut gold. Impressive.

lines.zh: 核心还在转，我就还能打。
lines.en: My core still turns, so I can still fight.

lines.zh: 弹簧被震歪了，我扶正它。
lines.en: The spring got knocked crooked; I straighten it.

lines.zh: 疼不疼无所谓，站得住就行。
lines.en: Pain does not matter as long as I stand.

lines.zh: 这一刀让我想起铸炉。
lines.en: That cut reminds me of the furnace.

lines.zh: 你伤的是壳，不是里面。
lines.en: You wounded the shell, not what is inside.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，换不来我停手。
lines.en: What you hold will not buy my halt.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我的核心自己烧。
lines.en: I do not eat; my core burns on its own.

lines.zh: 收起你的诱饵，我不是野兽。
lines.en: Put your bait away; I am no beast.

lines.zh: 那块金子我倒是想要。
lines.en: That piece of gold, though, I would take.

lines.zh: 拿食物对付战士，太失礼了。
lines.en: Offering food to a warrior is an insult.

lines.zh: 我的嘴是铸出来的，不会嚼。
lines.en: My mouth was cast; it does not chew.

lines.zh: 你晃那袋东西，我只想打你。
lines.en: Shake that pouch and I only want to hit you more.

lines.zh: 别用这种办法试探我。
lines.en: Do not test me this way.

lines.zh: 我认得饥饿，但那不是我的。
lines.en: I know hunger, but it is not mine.

lines.zh: 放下，然后拿起你的武器。
lines.en: Put it down, then pick up your weapon.

lines.zh: 你撞在我甲上，自己弹开了。
lines.en: You struck my armor and bounced off.

lines.zh: 让开，我的路是直的。
lines.en: Move; my path is straight.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我们各退半步。
lines.en: That collision pushed us each back half a step.

lines.zh: 我的肩甲有一块是补的。
lines.en: One plate on my shoulder is a patch.

lines.zh: 别蹭我的甲，会磨掉镀层。
lines.en: Stop rubbing my plate; you will wear the coating off.

lines.zh: 你的重量不够，撞不动我。
lines.en: You lack the weight to move me.

lines.zh: 金属碰金属，声音挺脆。
lines.en: Metal on metal makes a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 这道门归我守，你过不去。
lines.en: This door is mine to keep; you will not pass.

lines.zh: 撞完你还站着，我记下了。
lines.en: You are still standing after that. Noted.

lines.zh: 退开，否则下一次我用拳头。
lines.en: Back off, or the next contact is my fist.

lines.zh: 战士没有伴侣，只有对手。
lines.en: A warrior has no mate, only opponents.

lines.zh: 我的身体是铸的，不繁殖。
lines.en: My body was cast; it does not breed.

lines.zh: 你想找同伴，去别的大厅。
lines.en: If you seek company, find another hall.

lines.zh: 别靠过来，我会当成进攻。
lines.en: Do not come closer; I will take it as an attack.

lines.zh: 两颗核心靠太近，会烧起来。
lines.en: Two cores too close would burn.

lines.zh: 我这副甲里没有温热的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing warm inside this armor.

lines.zh: 跟我配对，你得先赢我。
lines.en: To pair with me, you must beat me first.

lines.zh: 我不懂这种事，也不打算学。
lines.en: I do not understand such things, nor plan to learn.

lines.zh: 走开，我站岗的时候不说话。
lines.en: Leave; I do not talk while on duty.

lines.zh: 唯一的伴侣是这把旧锤。
lines.en: My only companion is this old hammer.

lines.zh: 这块金片，我捡起来收好。
lines.en: I pick up this gold shard and stow it.

lines.zh: 地上的东西不属于战士。
lines.en: What lies on the ground does not belong to a warrior.

lines.zh: 我手上全是油，抓不住细的。
lines.en: My hands are all oil; I cannot grip small things.

lines.zh: 这块矿可以补我的肩甲。
lines.en: This ore could patch my shoulder plate.

lines.zh: 你的箭我踩弯了，抱歉。
lines.en: I bent your arrow underfoot. Apologies.

lines.zh: 我不捡别人的战利品。
lines.en: I do not pick up another's spoils.

lines.zh: 能重铸的带走，其余留给沙。
lines.en: What can be reforged comes with me; the rest stays for the sand.

lines.zh: 这把断剑，我可以重铸。
lines.en: This broken sword I could reforge.

lines.zh: 先打完，再谈这些东西。
lines.en: We finish the fight first, then discuss these things.

lines.zh: 弯腰的时候，我的关节会响。
lines.en: When I bend, my joints complain.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的地盘，电流就醒了。
lines.en: You stepped onto my ground and the current woke.

lines.zh: 我的视野里，你已经标红了。
lines.en: In my sight you are already marked red.

lines.zh: 有别的东西在动，我选你。
lines.en: Several things move; I choose you.

lines.zh: 你身上的金属味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the metal on you.

lines.zh: 目标确认，会喘气的那一个。
lines.en: Target confirmed: the one that breathes.

lines.zh: 我不追逃兵，但你还算站着。
lines.en: I do not chase runaways, but you still stand.

lines.zh: 弹簧绷紧了，我停不下来。
lines.en: The spring is wound; I cannot stop now.

lines.zh: 你的脚步乱了，我就知道是你。
lines.en: Your steps faltered, and I knew it was you.

lines.zh: 这片黄金地，只认一个主人。
lines.en: This golden ground acknowledges only one master.

lines.zh: 别急着跑，让我看清你的护甲。
lines.en: Do not run yet; let me see your armor.

lines.zh: 我的核心在响，像在催我。
lines.en: My core hums as if urging me on.

lines.zh: 你身上的热量，在金属里很清楚。
lines.en: Your body heat shows clearly against the metal.

lines.zh: 我的核心认得你，就记到底。
lines.en: Once my core knows you, it remembers to the end.

lines.zh: 打之前，我想知道你的名字。
lines.en: Before we fight, I want to know your name.

lines.zh: 我的拳头悬着，等你先动。
lines.en: My fist hangs ready; you move first.

lines.zh: 你的重心在左脚，我看出来了。
lines.en: Your weight is on the left foot. I noticed.

lines.zh: 这道电流在我指间来回跳。
lines.en: The current jumps back and forth between my fingers.

lines.zh: 你退，我就进，一步换一步。
lines.en: You retreat, I advance, step for step.

lines.zh: 你抬臂那一瞬，缝就开了。
lines.en: The instant you raise that arm, a seam opens.

lines.zh: 距离还有三步，刚好。
lines.en: Three steps of distance. Just right.

lines.zh: 你身后是墙，你自己知道吗。
lines.en: There is a wall behind you. Do you know that?

lines.zh: 我没眼睑，闭不上这双铸眼。
lines.en: I have no lids to close these cast eyes.

lines.zh: 你在拖延，我也在等破绽。
lines.en: You stall, and I wait for your opening.

lines.zh: 这一场，我打算赢得干净。
lines.en: I intend to win this one cleanly.

lines.zh: 别把盾举太高，会挡住视线。
lines.en: Do not raise the shield so high; it blocks your view.

lines.zh: 我的弹簧在倒数。
lines.en: My spring is counting down.

lines.zh: 你握剑的手在颤，我数着呢。
lines.en: Your sword hand trembles, and I am counting.

lines.zh: 我站定不动，是因为稳。
lines.en: I stand motionless because stillness is steady.

lines.zh: 黄金地面把我的影子照得发亮
lines.en: The golden floor makes my shadow shine.

lines.zh: 这一拳带着电，接稳了。
lines.en: This fist carries a charge. Take it.

lines.zh: 我在你护甲接缝处下手。
lines.en: I strike at the seam of your armor.

lines.zh: 弹簧一松，力就到了。
lines.en: The spring releases and the force arrives.

lines.zh: 你的盾凹了一块，可惜。
lines.en: Your shield has a dent now. A shame.

lines.zh: 我打三下，留一下给你喘。
lines.en: I strike three times and leave one for you to breathe.

lines.zh: 黄金手臂砸下来，很沉。
lines.en: A golden arm comes down, and it is heavy.

lines.zh: 这一击我练了千百次。
lines.en: I have practiced this blow a thousand times.

lines.zh: 你退得不错，可惜慢半拍。
lines.en: Good retreat, but half a beat too slow.

lines.zh: 这一拳下去，你的肋骨会唱歌。
lines.en: After this punch your ribs will sing.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，会断。
lines.en: Do not block with your hand; it will break.

lines.zh: 我的指节上有一道旧裂痕。
lines.en: There is an old crack on my knuckle.

lines.zh: 这一下是为了你那面破盾。
lines.en: That one was for your cracked shield.

lines.zh: 你还有力气站起来，很好。
lines.en: You still have strength to stand. Good.

lines.zh: 打完了我会把拳头收回去。
lines.en: When it is done, I will draw my fist back.

lines.zh: 我这一拳先出，电后到
lines.en: My fist goes first; the current follows.

lines.zh: 你被震得退开，鞋底冒烟
lines.en: The shock throws you back, soles smoking.

lines.zh: 我在这座金色的大厅里铸成。
lines.en: I was forged in this golden hall.

lines.zh: 炉火灭了，我站起来。
lines.en: The furnace went out, and I stood up.

lines.zh: 黄金地面认得我的脚。
lines.en: The gold floor knows my feet.

lines.zh: 我从架子上下来，落了灰。
lines.en: I stepped down from the rack, shedding dust.

lines.zh: 这里太安静，该有人来打了。
lines.en: It is too quiet here; someone should come and fight.

lines.zh: 铸炉开火，我胸口的核才亮。
lines.en: The forge lit, and only then did my chest core glow.

lines.zh: 铸我的时候，锤子敲了很久。
lines.en: The hammer struck a long time when they made me.

lines.zh: 我一睁眼，就看见满地的金。
lines.en: I opened my eyes to gold everywhere.

lines.zh: 这副身体是为战斗做的。
lines.en: This body was made for battle.

lines.zh: 有人把我放在这里，然后走了。
lines.en: Someone set me here, then left.

lines.zh: 弹簧上还挂着油。
lines.en: Oil still clings to my springs.

lines.zh: 站岗第一天，就有人闯进来。
lines.en: On my first day of guard duty, someone broke in.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的甲，烫得发白。
lines.en: Fire heats my armor until it glows white.

lines.zh: 落地的第一下，膝盖替我扛了。
lines.en: My knees took the first hit of that landing.

lines.zh: 水进了关节，我动得很慢。
lines.en: Water got into my joints and I move slowly.

lines.zh: 气浪推我滑出两步。
lines.en: The blast slid me back two steps.

lines.zh: 箭卡在甲缝里，正好卡住。
lines.en: The arrow is jammed in a plate seam, stuck fast.

lines.zh: 这股药味让我核心发闷。
lines.en: This potion scent makes my core sluggish.

lines.zh: 我的核心烧得越来越弱。
lines.en: My core burns weaker and weaker.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，反倒充了电。
lines.en: Lightning struck me and, oddly, recharged me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有金属，我听不见。
lines.en: There is no metal in the void; I hear nothing.
